title: Endpoint selection for declared connections
software_contract: Call min_vertex_cover_bruteforce(edges, n). Return a set of indices containing at least one endpoint of each edge. Minimize the number of selected indices; ties choose the lexicographically smallest sorted tuple of selected indices. Empty edges return the empty set. Do not mutate inputs. Only valid-domain inputs are specified; no extra invalid-input validation requirement is added in this core view.
input_domain: n is a Python int (not bool), 0–16. edges is a list of distinct (u,v) integer tuples with 0<=u<v<n. All indices are available at unit selection cost, with no capacity or scheduling restrictions. The bound is a local testing limit, not workload evidence.
execution_assumptions: Ordinary classical input; no hardware, latency or benefit assumptions supplied.
